title: Project Intake Manager - D&C Project Controls Program
description:
JLL supports the Whole You, personally and professionally.
  
  
Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology to our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people in our industry; and we support them through professional growth, flexibility, and personalized benefits to manage life in and outside of work. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades, and technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, we empower you to shape a brighter way forward so you can thrive professionally and personally.
  
  
Position Overview
  
The Project Intake Manager serves as the regional point of contact for all incoming project requests within the Design & Construction (D&C) team ranging from new construction, renovations (large/medium) and small scale projects across an organization. This role ensures efficient project initiation by evaluating requests, verifying completeness of information, routing to appropriate resource groups, and coordinating across multiple stakeholder teams. The position combines operational coordination with analytical capabilities to optimize intake processes and provide performance insights with clear SLA targets for each project type.
  
Key Responsibilities
  
Request Management & Coordination
  
Serve as primary regional point of contact for all D&C Project Controls Program intake requests to internal clients, partner teams, and D&C leadership, communicating performance, negotiating priorities, and ensuring alignment across business units and regions.
  
Oversees end-to-end intake execution across AMER, EMEA, and APAC, ensuring reactive (1-5 days) and proactive (25–40 day) tracks stay on target while monitoring AI-triage performance and Coordinator workload balance.
  
Determine scoping/feasibility requirements, appropriate resource groups and team assignments based on project characteristics, expertise requirements, and capacity.
  
Facilitate smooth handoffs between intake and project execution teams, ensuring continuity of information and stakeholder expectations.
  
Enforces documentation standards, conducts audits and peer reviews, validates routing accuracy and AI-triage quality, and maintains standardized templates and process documentation.
  
Resolves complex routing decisions, resource conflicts, priority disputes, and ambiguous categorization across stakeholder teams.
  
Information Verification & Quality Control
  
Evaluate completeness and quality of initial project information including scope definitions, budgets, timelines, and stakeholder documentation.
  
Identify gaps in project requirements and engage requestors to gather missing details before assignment.
  
Maintain standardized intake templates and checklists to ensure consistent information capture across all requests.
  
Enforce documentation standards that enable accurate project scoping and reduce downstream rework.
  
Stakeholder Coordination & Communication
  
Lead intake calls (weekly/bi-weekly) and kickoff meetings with internal clients, project sponsors, and D&C Project Controls teams.Coordinate across multiple stakeholder groups including operations, finance, real estate, facilities, and business units.
  
Communicate project status, routing decisions, and next steps to all relevant parties throughout the intake lifecycle.
  
Serve as a trusted liaison between requestors and delivery teams, ensuring alignment on expectations and priorities.
  
Reporting & Analytics
  
Monitor dashboards tracking intake volume, request types, assignment patterns, and processing timelines.
  
Analyze performance metrics including time-to-assignment, request completion rates, and resource utilization.
  
Identify trends, bottlenecks, and opportunities for process improvement within the intake workflow.
  
Prepare regular reports on intake productivity, team performance, and operational efficiency for D&C Project Controls leadership.
  
Process Optimization
  
Continuously evaluate and refine intake procedures to improve efficiency and stakeholder experience.
  
Recommend and implement improvements to intake forms, routing criteria, and coordination protocols.
  
Collaborate with D&C Project Controls leadership to establish service level agreements and performance standards.
  
Maintain comprehensive documentation of intake processes, routing guidelines, and best practices.
  
  
Required Qualifications
  
Experience
  
5-7 years of experience in project management, project coordination, change management, operations, or related roles within corporate real estate, facilities management, design and construction, or professional services environments.
  
Demonstrated experience managing workflows across multiple teams and stakeholder groups.
  
Background in process improvement, change management and operational efficiency initiatives.
  
Skills & Competencies
  
Strong organizational abilities with excellent attention to detail and ability to manage multiple concurrent requests.
  
Exceptional communication skills with confidence leading meetings and coordinating across diverse stakeholder groups at all organizational levels.
  
Analytical mindset with ability to interpret data, identify trends, and translate insights into actionable recommendations.
  
Proficiency in project management principles and understanding of design and construction project lifecycles and project controls methodologies.
  
Advanced skills in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and data visualization tools for reporting and analytics.
  
Use and knowledge of ai-tools preferred.
  
Experience with project management systems, intake platforms, or workflow management software
  
Personal Attributes
  
Customer service orientation with commitment to stakeholder satisfaction.
  
Proactive problem-solver who can work independently while collaborating effectively across teams.Adaptable and comfortable managing ambiguity in a dynamic, fast-paced environment, evolving product landscape.
  
Strong business acumen with ability to understand organizational priorities and make sound routing decisions.
  
If this job description resonates with you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all of the requirements below. We’re interested in getting to know you and what you bring to the table!
  
  
Personalized benefits that support personal well-being and growth:
  
  
JLL recognizes the impact that the workplace can have on your wellness, so we offer a supportive culture and comprehensive benefits package that prioritizes mental, physical and emotional health.
  
  
About JLL –
  
  
We’re JLL—a leading professional services and investment management firm specializing in real estate. We have operations in over 80 countries and a workforce of over 102,000 individuals around the world who help real estate owners, occupiers and investors achieve their business ambitions. As a global Fortune 500 company, we also have an inherent responsibility to drive sustainability and corporate social responsibility. That’s why we’re committed to our purpose to shape the future of real estate for a better world. We’re using the most advanced technology to create rewarding opportunities, amazing spaces and sustainable real estate solutions for our clients, our people, and our communities.
  
  
Our core values of teamwork, ethics and excellence are also fundamental to everything we do and we’re honored to be recognized with awards for our success by organizations both globally and locally.
  
  
Creating a diverse and inclusive culture where we all feel welcomed, valued and empowered to achieve our full potential is important to who we are today and where we’re headed in the future. And we know that unique backgrounds, experiences and perspectives help us think bigger, spark innovation and succeed together.

title: Technical Program Manager, Google Enterprise Networks Workspace Delivery
description:
### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in a technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 2 years of experience in program management.
* Experience in network infrastructure.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* 2 years of experience managing cross-functional or cross-team projects.
* Experience in technical program management, product lifecycle management, agile project management, enterprise networking, network infrastructure, network infrastructure devices.
* Experience in planning, designing and implementation change/transformational programs.

The Core team builds the technical foundation behind Google’s flagship products. We are owners and advocates for the underlying design elements, developer platforms, product components, and infrastructure at Google. These are the essential building blocks for excellent, safe, and coherent experiences for our users and drive the pace of innovation for every developer. We look across Google’s products to build central solutions, break down technical barriers and strengthen existing systems. As the Core team, we have a mandate and a unique opportunity to impact important technical decisions across the company.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Manage and drive the delivery of network infrastructure programs/projects while leveraging automation and software programs by coordinating with global delivery teams across the company to facilitate efficient network services to customers.
* Manage third-party vendors responsible for the monitoring and troubleshooting of network services, including facilitating any escalations requiring engineering assistance and develop comprehensive reports to track scope, schedule, budget, risks, and overall project status.
* Partner with network engineers, software engineers, and project managers to deliver large technical networking projects and Manage third-party vendors contracted for the monitoring and troubleshooting of network services. Facilitate the escalation of issues requiring engineering assistance with the vendors.
* Design and implement new delivery processes, enact process improvement measures, and ensure the efficient and reliable achievement of process objectives and optimize operational processes essential for maintaining business operations.

Job Title

Deputy Chief Manager – Mechanical / Civil Projects

Job Description

The Dy. Chief Manager – Mechanical / Civil Projects will be responsible for planning, coordinating, and executing mechanical and civil engineering activities for Greenfield and Brownfield pharmaceutical and API projects. The role involves managing engineering design reviews, contractor execution, equipment installation, construction supervision, project monitoring, and compliance with GMP, EHS, and statutory requirements to ensure timely and cost-effective project delivery.

**Band:** 2C  
**Department:** Global Engineering & Projects  
**Location:** Digwal  
**Reports To:** GM Project / Project Head
  
**Employment Type:** Full-time / Permanent

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **1. Project Execution & Coordination**

* Execute mechanical and civil project activities from concept through commissioning.
* Coordinate with consultants, contractors, vendors, and internal stakeholders for project implementation.
* Monitor project schedules, resources, and progress against approved timelines.
* Ensure completion of assigned projects within budget, quality, and schedule requirements.
* Support project planning, estimation, and budgeting activities.

### **2. Mechanical Engineering**

* Review and monitor installation of reactors, tanks, pressure vessels, piping systems, utility equipment, and material handling systems.
* Participate in equipment selection, vendor evaluation, technical bid reviews, and FAT/SAT activities.
* Ensure compliance with design specifications, GMP requirements, and engineering standards.
* Coordinate commissioning and performance testing of mechanical systems.
* Support troubleshooting during installation and startup activities.

### **3. Civil & Structural Engineering**

* Supervise construction activities including buildings, foundations, roads, drains, pipe racks, utility corridors, and infrastructure works.
* Review civil drawings, BOQs, structural layouts, and contractor submissions.
* Ensure construction quality as per approved drawings, specifications, and project standards.
* Monitor contractor productivity, material utilization, and work progress.
* Coordinate with architects and structural consultants for timely issue resolution.

### **4. Safety, Quality & Compliance**

* Ensure implementation of EHS requirements at project sites.
* Participate in risk assessments, Job Safety Analysis (JSA), and safety audits.
* Monitor contractor compliance with safety regulations and permit-to-work systems.
* Ensure all construction and installation activities comply with GMP, statutory, and corporate requirements.
* Support regulatory inspections and compliance audits.

### **5. Contractor & Vendor Management**

* Monitor contractor performance, productivity, and resource deployment.
* Verify contractor bills, measurement sheets, and work completion certifications.
* Coordinate with procurement for timely material and equipment delivery.
* Ensure contractual obligations are fulfilled by contractors and suppliers.

### **6. Documentation & Reporting**

* Prepare weekly and monthly project progress reports.
* Maintain project documentation, drawings, change controls, and engineering records.
* Track project risks, delays, and mitigation plans.
* Present project status updates during management review meetings.

**Qualifications & Experience**
-------------------------------

### **Education**

* B.E./B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering or Civil Engineering.
* Project Management certification will be an added advantage.

### **Experience**

* **12–18 years** of relevant experience in pharmaceutical, API, chemical, or industrial projects.
* Experience in execution of Greenfield and Brownfield projects.
* Hands-on experience in construction management, equipment installation, and utility projects.
* Exposure to GMP-compliant manufacturing facilities preferred.
* Familiarity with project planning and scheduling tools.

**Technical Skills**
--------------------

* Mechanical equipment installation and commissioning.
* Civil construction and infrastructure development.
* Knowledge of P&IDs, equipment layouts, GA drawings, and civil/structural drawings.
* Understanding of HVAC, utilities, piping, and industrial construction practices.
* AutoCAD and MS Project knowledge preferred.
* Knowledge of GMP, EHS, and regulatory requirements.

--------------------

* Strong project execution and coordination skills.
* Contractor and stakeholder management.
* Problem-solving and decision-making ability.
* Planning and organizational skills.
* Effective communication and teamwork.
* Result-oriented with strong ownership mindset.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

Acting as the client’s planning and controls representative, the role ensures that integrated master schedules, progress reporting, and forecasting frameworks are robust, accurate, and aligned with delivery objectives. 2. Key Responsibilities
  
Planning & Controls Leadership
  
Lead planning and controls activities across the full project lifecycle, including design, procurement, construction, commissioning, and handover.
  
  
Develop, maintain, and govern integrated master schedules and detailed project programs in alignment with PMC and client standards.
  
  
Establish planning principles, schedule structures, coding, and reporting frameworks across the project portfolio.
  
  
Act as the central authority for schedule integrity, logic, and baseline management.
  
  
Schedule Development & Governance

Ensure alignment of design, procurement, construction, and commissioning activities across all workstreams.

Support phasing strategies, fast-track delivery, and concurrent construction models common to data center projects.
  
  
Progress Monitoring, Analysis & Reporting
  
Implement consistent progress measurement methodologies across all disciplines and contractors.
  
  
Track progress against baselines, identify variances, and provide forward-looking forecasts.
  
  
Prepare high-quality schedule reports, dashboards, and executive summaries for client and project leadership.
  
  
Highlight risks to milestones and critical paths, with clear mitigation and recovery options.
  
  
Risk, Change & Recovery Planning
  
Support identification of schedule-related risks and development of mitigation strategies.
  
  
Perform schedule impact assessments for changes, delays, and scope adjustments.
  
  
Support recovery planning, acceleration strategies, and what-if scenario analysis.

**The Role**


We are looking for a Technology Program Manager who can drive complex, cross\-functional technology initiatives from problem definition to execution and delivery.  

  

This is not a traditional Scrum Master / Agile Project Manager role.  

  

You will work in an environment where requirements evolve, priorities change, teams may not be co\-located, and there isn't always a well\-defined process or single owner for every dependency.  

  

Your job will be to bring clarity, structure and momentum to these situations.  

  

You will work closely with Product, Engineering, Design, Data, Operations and external technology partners to ensure that complex initiatives move forward and eventually reach production.

* Drive end\-to\-end technology programs — translate high\-level objectives into clear plans, milestones, dependencies and execution paths.

* Work closely with engineering leads to understand architecture, APIs, data flows, system dependencies and technical constraints well enough to identify execution risks early.
* Identify the critical path for programs and continuously remove blockers that could impact delivery.
* Coordinate execution across distributed and non\-co\-located teams, ensuring alignment without relying purely on formal processes.
* Bring structure to ambiguous problems — figure out what needs to happen, who needs to be involved and how we get from where we are today to the desired outcome.
* Identify risks, dependencies and decisions proactively rather than waiting for issues to surface.
* Facilitate discussions between teams when there are conflicting priorities, unclear ownership or competing technical approaches.
* Partner with Product Managers and Engineering Managers to convert product/business objectives into executable technology plans.
* Maintain program visibility for leadership — what is on track, what is blocked, why it is blocked and what decisions are required.
* Manage execution across multiple parallel workstreams without becoming a task tracker.
* Work with external vendors/partners where technology integration or operational dependencies are involved.
* Establish lightweight processes where needed — but avoid adding process for the sake of process.

* Strong ability to understand technical dependencies and identify risks before they become delivery problems.
* Comfortable working with ambiguity, changing priorities and incomplete information.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, particularly across teams with different priorities.
* Ability to operate effectively with distributed / geographically dispersed engineering teams.
* Strong ownership mindset — you see a problem through to resolution rather than simply escalating it.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.

* Experience working with microservices, APIs, cloud infrastructure or data platforms.
* Engineering / Computer Science background.
* Experience working with external technology vendors or partners.
* Experience managing programs involving multiple engineering teams and complex integrations.
* Experience in an environment where Product and Engineering operate with high autonomy and lightweight processes.

* Which teams and systems are involved?
* What are the critical dependencies?
* What is blocking us?
* Who needs to make a decision?
* What can derail the program?

**You need to make complex things happen.**
